experiment_data.hypothesis: Max-confidence and none-aware routing strategies can recover a significant fraction of the oracle routing gain (+29.8pp over single-pass) by using LLM generation logprobs to select the most reliable sub-schema prediction, since the correct sub-schema should produce higher-confidence predictions than sub-schemas forced to classify into unrelated types.

metrics.key_finding: All practical routing strategies perform worse than single-pass. Structured decoding forces confident predictions even for wrong sub-schemas, making confidence-based and none-aware routing ineffective. Oracle gain (+22pp) is not recoverable via post-hoc routing.
